title: Tic-Tac-Toe

scenario.title: The board comes from a share link
scenario.body: A link like ?board=XXXOOO... is someone else's input. It can be nine perfectly valid characters and still describe a game nobody could play: two winners, five Xs and no Os, a move after the game is over. The book checks the shape. These tests check that it makes sense.

note: One of the book's tests expects argparse's error message as Python 3.8 wrote it (invalid choice: 10). Python 3.12 and later quote the value ('10'), so a solution that leans on choices= fails on a modern Python. Tests can pin more than they mean to.
tagline: Play noughts and crosses. Ref Robo checks every move and shouts when someone wins. Then try sneaking it a board that could never happen.

brain_blurbs.book: Checks the board has the right letters.
brain_blurbs.real: Also checks the game could really have happened.

rules.test_exists: Ref Robo is on the field
rules.test_usage: Explains the rules when you ask
rules.test_no_input: Draws an empty board numbered 1 to 9
rules.test_bad_board: Rejects boards with odd letters or the wrong size
rules.test_bad_player: Only X and O can play
rules.test_bad_cell_int: Cells go from 1 to 9, not 0 or 10
rules.test_bad_cell_str: A cell has to be a number
rules.test_both_player_and_cell: A move needs a player and a cell
rules.test_good_board_02: Draws a board with moves on it
rules.test_mutate_cell_taken: No playing on a taken cell
rules.test_winning: Spots every way to win: rows, columns, diagonals
rules.test_losing: Doesn't call a winner too early
rules.test_board_with_board: Draws the grid with X and O
rules.test_two_winners_is_impossible: X and O can't BOTH have won
rules.test_turns_alternate: Five X and no O? Somebody cheated
rules.test_no_moves_after_a_win: No more moves once someone has won
rules.test_lowercase_is_rejected_not_guessed: A small x isn't an X
rules.test_rotating_keeps_the_winner: Turn the board around: same winner
rules.test_mirroring_keeps_the_winner: Look in a mirror: same winner
rules.test_swapping_players_swaps_the_winner: Swap X and O: the other one wins
